name: rigsmith

scripts.check: npm run check:app && npm run check:tools
scripts.test:python: .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s blender/autorig -p 'test_*.py' && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s blender/library -p 'test_*.py' && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tools/skin_opt -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.library:sync: python3 blender/library/catalog.py sync && npm run library && npm run library:verify
scripts.setup:python: uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r tools/requirements.txt && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r tools/requirements-torch.txt

description: Personal character pipeline for Emberhold's units: import, skeleton, skin, gear, look, motion, and ship to the game.
